hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements staking and reward distribution for SuperDCA token pools. Users stake SuperDCATokens to direct emissions to specific pools; accrued rewards are minted and split 50/50 between a developer address and the pool (via donation). The hook also applies dynamic LP fees, giving allowlisted "internal" addresses a 0% fee and all others a 1% fee.
